system.description: As a Swift Action, you become immune to the Sense Force application of the Use the Force skill, and appear to be nothing more than a regular Droid in The Force. If you make a Use the Force check or use any Force Power or Force Talent, this effect immediately ends.

prerequisite.text: a member of The Iron Knights

nodes.text: a member of The Iron Knights
